name: 6 Mile Bounty Hunna Watts Bloods
description: 6 Mile Bounty Hunna Watts Bloods (6M BHB) is a Blood-affiliated street gang based in Detroit, operating under Bounty Hunter Watts lineage. The set is documented in conflict with the 7 Mile Rollin' 60s Crips and the Eastside Rollin' 80s Skyline Pirus, and members are noted to participate in the 7654 network.

sources.title: Inside the Powerful Rise of 7 Mile Rollin' 60s Crips in Detroit – DetroitStreetGangs.com
